summary: Fire during start-up of the citral plant at BASF Ludwigshafen; plant shut down and force majeure declared for citral and isoprenol based aroma ingredients.
Construction of Wanhua's citral project in Yantai started in February 2022 (EIA report, 2025).
Wanhua's Yantai citral project was completed and commissioned in September 2024 (EIA report, 2025).
BASF said it still expected to restart the Ludwigshafen citral plant in March 2018 at the earliest, after the October 2017 fire.
Fire at a BASF Ludwigshafen facility; BASF declared force majeure on selected aroma ingredients including ionones (not specific to beta-ionone).
Fire at BASF Ludwigshafen plant halted production; BASF declared force majeure on some products including Ionones (unspecified whether beta-ionone specifically).
Board approved a planned new unit for 3,000 t/a fragrances incl. 100 t/a dihydromyrcenol. Planned only; the quote gives no site and does not show production.
Mutares acquired AmeriTerpenes, the terpene ingredients business of Symrise Inc., as part of a carve-out. Sites in Jacksonville, FL and Colonels Island, GA; products include linalool.
Kuraray announced it will cease production of linalool and its derivatives at its Niigata Plant by end of March 2008, citing raw material prices and international competition.
BASF announced it lifted force majeure for several products made across its global network, including at its Ludwigshafen site, which produces feed- and food-grade vitamin A and E ingredients.
Symrise says its expanded menthol capacities are in operation, doubling production volume. No tonnage is given; the release does not name a site in the quoted sentence.
Symrise reportedly invested in expanding extraction capacity for beta-ionone at a European site. No tonnage or site name is given.
BASF states commercial production of menthol and linalool began in April 2026 at Ludwigshafen. The release gives no linalool tonnage.
Wanhua Chemical launched a 48,000-ton-per-year citral production facility in Yantai, China, per trade press.
BASF announced that its Zhanjiang citral plant has produced in-spec product since Q1 2026; the release gives no tonnage.
Symrise sold its AmeriTerpenes terpene ingredients business (Jacksonville FL and Colonels Island GA sites) to private equity investor Mutares. Date is the trade press article date.
BASF anticipates a 10% increase in annual vitamin E acetate production capacity by 2027 at its Ludwigshafen site, enabled by a low-double-digit million-euro investment.
BASF announced a new citral plant at its Zhanjiang Verbund site in China; the plant and the Ludwigshafen downstream units were expected to come on stream from 2026.
Zhanjiang citral plant began producing on-specification product in Q1 2026 and began supplying customers in April 2026.
BASF officially inaugurated its new citral plant in Ludwigshafen, reported as 40,000 metric tons per year, in August 2004.
BASF announced a 10% expansion of vitamin E acetate capacity in January 2025, expected to reach 16,500 tonnes/year by 2027 (per Expana, 2025-08-07).
Fire at the Ludwigshafen citral plant. BASF declared force majeure on citral and, per trade press, halted production of vitamin A and E and several carotenoids.
Explosion and fire at a Ludwigshafen plant making aroma ingredients and vitamin precursors. BASF declared force majeure on supply of vitamin A, vitamin E and carotenoids.
Kuraray discontinued manufacturing at its Niigata Plant on March 31, 2008; linalool was on the December 2007 list of products to cease production by end of March 2008.
Official opening of DSM's new vitamin E plant at the former Roche site in Sisseln, Switzerland, reported 13 Sep 2004.
Linax is reported as acquired in 2023; the source describes it as the division housing the company's R&D laboratory.
BASF announced a new vitamin A production complex at Ludwigshafen, with start-up expected in 2020.
Explosion and fire at a plant in the southern section of BASF's Ludwigshafen complex; BASF then declared force majeure on supply of vitamin A, vitamin E and carotenoids.
Mutares acquired AmeriTerpenes, Symrise's terpene ingredients business, in a carve-out. Mutares lists linalool in the portfolio and sites in Jacksonville, FL and Colonels Island, GA.
Xinhecheng's 5,000 t/yr menthol project (citral route) was completed and put into production in 2022, per a 2026 trade-research article.
DSM reported that COVID-19 and Yangtze flooding delayed the Yimante upgrade and restart; start-up was then expected by end of December 2020.
BASF announced investment in menthol and linalool downstream plants at its Ludwigshafen Verbund site; BASF said they were expected to come on stream from 2026 onwards.
BASF reported that commercial production of menthol and linalool at Ludwigshafen started in April 2026.
After a fire at a BASF plant in Ludwigshafen on 29 July 2024, BASF declared force majeure on selected aroma ingredients including Ionones and Isophytol R, until further notice. No restart date given.
Merck Ltd sought environmental clearance from MoEF to raise Vitamin E Acetate capacity from 25 MTPM to 50 MTPM within the plant by increasing batch size and decreasing condensation period.
Merck Ltd proposed doubling Vitamin E Acetate output at Usgaon, Goa (25 to 50 MTPM) via larger batch size and shorter condensation period; approval/completion not confirmed.
BASF announced intensified investment in vitamin E production at Ludwigshafen (10% more annual vitamin E acetate capacity expected by 2027, per trade press).
BASF lifted force majeure on Vitamin E Acetate 94% following the 2017 citral plant fire at Ludwigshafen.
Vitamin A plant expansion in Ludwigshafen described as the '2021 vitamin A plant expansion' by trade press in July 2022.
Symrise reported expanded menthol capacities in operation and said it was investing in the Bushy Park facility to process greater volume flows. No Bushy Park tonnage given.
Company said the phase 1 and phase 2 land and plant areas of the Xinchang pharmaceutical plant will be de-functionalised by end-2024; capacity to be transferred to other subsidiaries.
Combustible-gas flash explosion during welding at a wastewater treatment tank at 金达威维生素's Xiamen Haicang site; 4 killed, 2 injured, direct loss about 530万元.

Company said the Xinchang pharmaceutical plant's phase I and II plots and plant area will be decommissioned by end-2024; products to move to other subsidiaries, with an expected supply gap on some items.
DSM announced in November 2022 a temporary halt of Vitamin A production at Sisseln; production later resumed (Feb 2023).
